title: The Murder on the Links

vibeProfile.oneLine: Poirot arrives in France to find his client already murdered.

summary: Summoned to France by a frightened millionaire, Hercule Poirot arrives too late: his client is found stabbed in a shallow grave beside a golf course. As a rival detective backs the obvious theory, Poirot trusts his little grey cells and a tangle of buried pasts instead. An early, energetic Poirot mystery, it pits method against flashy guesswork and delivers the twists and misdirection that made Christie the queen of the form.
whyReadIt: Early, sprightly Poirot, with a rival detective to show off against. Pure comfort-read Christie.

funFacts.text: It was one of Christie's early novels to send Poirot abroad, a device she would use often.
